# casdoor_coupon (Resource)

Manages a Casdoor coupon, a discount code for orders.

Only the attributes set in the configuration are written to Casdoor. The other fields of the object, including the ones not listed here, keep their current values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "casdoor_coupon" "launch" {
  owner              = casdoor_organization.acme.name
  name               = "launch"
  display_name       = "Launch discount"
  code               = "LAUNCH20"
  discount_type      = "percentage"
  discount           = 20
  scope              = "universal"
  quantity           = 100
  max_usage_per_user = 1
  currency           = "USD"
  state              = "Active"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the coupon, unique within its owner.
- `owner` (String) The organization that the object belongs to.

### Optional

- `code` (String) The coupon code.
- `currency` (String) The currency, e.g. `USD`.
- `description` (String) The description.
- `discount` (Number) The discount: a percentage from 0 to 100, or a fixed amount.
- `discount_type` (String) The discount type, `percentage` or `fixed`.
- `display_name` (String) The display name.
- `expire_time` (String) The time when the coupon expires, in the RFC 3339 format.
- `max_discount` (Number) The maximum discount of a percentage coupon, 0 means unlimited.
- `max_usage_per_user` (Number) The number of times a user can use the coupon, 0 means unlimited.
- `min_order_amount` (Number) The minimum order amount that the coupon applies to.
- `products` (List of String) The products that the coupon applies to when the scope is `product`.
- `quantity` (Number) The number of times the coupon can be used in total, 0 means unlimited.
- `scope` (String) What the coupon applies to: `universal`, `product` or `user`.
- `start_time` (String) The time when the coupon becomes valid, in the RFC 3339 format.
- `state` (String) The state: `Active`, `Inactive` or `Expired`.
- `users` (List of String) The users that the coupon applies to when the scope is `user`.

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) The time when the coupon was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of the coupon in the `owner/name` format.
- `used_count` (Number) The number of times the coupon has been used.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the organization and the name.
terraform import casdoor_coupon.example <organization>/<name>
```
